faqs.question: What does general pest control in Midwood include?
faqs.answer: Our general pest control service covers common Brooklyn pests including cockroaches, ants, spiders, silverfish, mice, and rats. We perform a thorough inspection, apply targeted treatments to problem areas, seal entry points, and provide preventative measures.

faqs.question: Why does the price range?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on your property size, severity of infestation, and type of pests present. We provide transparent pricing before any work begins—call today for a free phone consultation.

faqs.question: How quickly can you service a Midwood property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for most Midwood locations. Our team understands that pest problems require urgent attention, especially in densely populated Brooklyn neighborhoods. Call us before noon, and we'll typically schedule your appointment within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Are your pest control treatments safe for families and pets?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We use EPA-registered products and offer eco-friendly, low-toxicity treatment options that are safe for children and pets when applied correctly. Our technicians are trained in the latest application methods to minimize exposure while maximizing effectiveness. We'll provide specific safety instructions for your particular treatment plan.
